comment: Names every content source the renderer reads so a publisher outside this repository can learn the shape without executing it. It grants nothing.

sections.comment: Per-page section records (page, order, eyebrow, title, lede, pattern, surface, optional facts/timeline/stats/services) with a markdown body. Frontmatter is Zod-validated by Astro's content layer.

insights.comment: Authored publications with a PDF and hero image per record. Media-bearing; not writable by any registration-grade operation.

pages.comment: Only home.md today, marked draft: true.

publicFactsInComponentCode.comment: Phone, email, street address, jurisdiction note, and the Wellington embassy details are hard-coded here. They are NOT a content source and are unwritable until moved into one data record.

hosting.comment: Deployed by CLI push of dist/, not by a git integration. The Business Agent publisher cannot settle Cloudflare Pages in its current build; publication requires a Vercel project or a recorded-envelope Cloudflare adapter.
